query: Which method can be used for oxidation resistance, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Alloying with chromium can be used for oxidation resistance
generation.mechanism: The chromium oxide layer acts as a barrier to prevent further oxidation of the underlying material
generation.baseline: Oxidation rate of the base material
generation.boundary: Temperature and chromium content thresholds beyond which the oxidation resistance is compromised
generation.uncertainty: The exact chromium content and temperature thresholds may vary depending on the specific alloy and application

falsification_experiment.design: Compare the oxidation rates of alloys with and without chromium additions in a high-temperature environment
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the oxidation rate of the alloy with chromium is not significantly lower than that of the alloy without chromium, the hypothesis is falsified
